text:
Alex: Need temporary read access to prod logs to pull a small PII sample for the redaction QA run. 
I want a 30m window to copy ~100 lines only, won't export off-host. Requesting assume-role `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/prod-logs-read/temp` or STS token. @Marie for approval, @security-bot FYI. 
Command I plan to run: ```aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/prod/2026-03-16/telemetry.gz - | zcat | grep -iE 'email|user_id' | head -n 100 > /tmp/pii-sample.txt```
Alex: I'll put the output in `s3://redwood-secure-temp/alex/pii-test/` with SSE-KMS and delete after 1h. This is to reproduce a false-negative in the redaction eval (PR #3456).

Marie: Quick Qs — can you confirm: 1) sample size (<=100 lines) 2) no copying to personal laptop, 3) deletion policy (automatic delete after 1h + manual confirm) and 4) which KMS key used? Also add me to the access audit.

Alex: Confirmed: 1) will cap at 100 lines, 2) won't copy to laptop (will work on Jumpbox if needed), 3) lifecycle: `aws s3 rm s3://redwood-secure-temp/alex/pii-test/ --recursive` scheduled at +60m and I'll post deletion confirmation, 4) KMS key: `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/secure-redaction-2024`. Window start: now (2026-03-16T14:10Z) for 30 minutes.

Marie: Approved for 30m window. Audit me (@Marie) on the access event and add the justification "redaction QA - PR #3456". No copies off-host, no screenshots. :white_check_mark:

security-bot: Approval recorded. Ticket SEC-2026-1789 created. Role assumption allowed for 1800s. Audit entry: user=Alex, approver=Marie, scope=s3:GetObject (redwood-logs), resource=s3://redwood-logs/prod/2026-03-16/*, reason="redaction QA - PR #3456".

OpsOnCall: heads-up — keep `--no-progress` on the cp to reduce noise and don't blast the bucket with parallel pulls. If you need more than 100 lines escalate.

Jamal: I'll stand by to review the sample once uploaded. If you can tag me in the object metadata `reviewer=Jamal` that'd help.

Sophia: Also make sure the role you assume has MPL (minimal privilege level) and that you enable session duration <= 30m.

Alex: Thanks all — assuming role and starting now. Will post object link when done and confirm deletion. :lock:
